Looking at your Power Query function, the problem is simple: it doesn't know which data belongs to which row. When you apply it to a table, it processes all the data each time and always picks the first result, giving the same value for every row.

### The Key Concept
In Power Query, when you create a custom function for table transformations, you need to make sure it knows which specific row it's currently processing. This is done by passing the current row's identifier (like a key) to the function and using it to filter the results.

### The Simple Solution
Add a parameter to your function that tells it which key to look for. Then, inside the function, add a filter step that only keeps records matching that specific key. This way, when Power Query processes Row 1, it only looks at Row 1's data, and when it processes Row 2, it only looks at Row 2's data.

### How to Apply This
1. Modify your function to accept a `currentKey` parameter
2. Add a filter step that uses this parameter to keep only matching records
3. Update how you call the function to pass the current row's key

When you use the function in a table transformation, pass the row's key like this:
`each DigHistory([changelog], sprintStartDate, "fieldName", [key])`

The `[key]` part is crucial—it tells the function "only look at data for this specific row."

### Why This Fixes the Problem
Without the key filter, the function treats all rows the same. With the key filter, each row gets processed independently, looking only at its own data. This ensures different rows get different values when their underlying data is different.

% DATABASE - Dynamic predicates for prayer times
database
    prayer_time_db(date, governorate, prayer, time, method)

% CLAUSES

% ============================================

% ============================================

% Prayer types
prayer("fajr").
prayer("dhuhr").
prayer("asr").
prayer("maghrib").
prayer("isha").

% Calculation methods
calculation_method("Egyptian_General_Authority").
calculation_method("Umm_al_Qura").
calculation_method("Muslim_World_League").

% ============================================
% 2. DATA GENERATION FOR ENTIRE YEAR
% ============================================

generate_year_data :-
    % Clear existing data
    retractall(prayer_time_db(_, _, _, _, _)),
    % Generate for current year
    getdate(Year, _, _),
    write("Generating prayer times for year ", Year, "..."), nl,
    generate_dates(Year, Dates),
    generate_for_all_dates(Dates),
    write("Prayer times generated successfully for ", Year), nl.

generate_dates(Year, Dates) :-
    findall(Date, (
        between(1, 12, Month),
        days_in_month(Year, Month, Days),
        between(1, Days, Day),
        format_date(Year, Month, Day, Date)
    ), Dates).

format_date(Year, Month, Day, Date) :-
    str_int(YearStr, Year),
    str_int(MonthStr, Month),
    str_int(DayStr, Day),
    concat(YearStr, "-", Temp1),
    concat(Temp1, MonthStr, Temp2),
    concat(Temp2, "-", Temp3),
    concat(Temp3, DayStr, Date).

days_in_month(Year, 2, Days) :-
    is_leap_year(Year), !,
    Days = 29.
days_in_month(_, 2, 28).
days_in_month(_, Month, 30) :-
    member(Month, [4, 6, 9, 11]).
days_in_month(_, Month, 31) :-
    member(Month, [1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12]).

is_leap_year(Year) :-
    Year mod 400 = 0, !.
is_leap_year(Year) :-
    Year mod 100 = 0, !,
    fail.
is_leap_year(Year) :-
    Year mod 4 = 0.

generate_for_all_dates([]).
generate_for_all_dates([Date|Rest]) :-
    governorate_info(Governorate, _, _),
    generate_prayer_for_date_governorate(Date, Governorate),
    generate_for_all_dates(Rest).

generate_prayer_for_date_governorate(Date, Governorate) :-
    governorate_info(Governorate, Lat, Long),
    calculate_prayer_time_by_method(Date, Lat, Long, "fajr", FajrTime, "Egyptian_General_Authority"),
    calculate_prayer_time_by_method(Date, Lat, Long, "dhuhr", DhuhrTime, "Egyptian_General_Authority"),
    calculate_prayer_time_by_method(Date, Lat, Long, "asr", AsrTime, "Egyptian_General_Authority"),
    calculate_prayer_time_by_method(Date, Lat, Long, "maghrib", MaghribTime, "Egyptian_General_Authority"),
    calculate_prayer_time_by_method(Date, Lat, Long, "isha", IshaTime, "Egyptian_General_Authority"),
    assert(prayer_time_db(Date, Governorate, "fajr", FajrTime, "Egyptian_General_Authority")),
    assert(prayer_time_db(Date, Governorate, "dhuhr", DhuhrTime, "Egyptian_General_Authority")),
    assert(prayer_time_db(Date, Governorate, "asr", AsrTime, "Egyptian_General_Authority")),
    assert(prayer_time_db(Date, Governorate, "maghrib", MaghribTime, "Egyptian_General_Authority")),
    assert(prayer_time_db(Date, Governorate, "isha", IshaTime, "Egyptian_General_Authority")).

% ============================================
% 3. PRAYER TIME CALCULATION WITH GEOGRAPHICAL VARIATIONS
% ============================================

calculate_prayer_time(Date, Governorate, Prayer, Time, Method) :-
    governorate_info(Governorate, Lat, Long),
    calculate_prayer_time_by_method(Date, Lat, Long, Prayer, Time, Method).

% Egyptian General Authority method with geographical adjustments
calculate_prayer_time_by_method(Date, Lat, Long, "fajr", Time, "Egyptian_General_Authority") :-
    calculate_solar_time(Date, Lat, Long, Sunrise, _),
    % Adjust angle based on latitude (Egypt-specific)
    (Lat > 28 -> Angle = -19.5; Angle = -18.0),
    calculate_time_offset(Sunrise, Angle, Time).

calculate_prayer_time_by_method(Date, Lat, Long, "dhuhr", Time, "Egyptian_General_Authority") :-
    calculate_solar_time(Date, Lat, Long, Sunrise, Sunset),
    calculate_solar_noon(Sunrise, Sunset, Time).

calculate_prayer_time_by_method(Date, Lat, Long, "asr", Time, "Egyptian_General_Authority") :-
    calculate_solar_time(Date, Lat, Long, Sunrise, Sunset),
    calculate_asr_time(Sunrise, Sunset, Time).

calculate_prayer_time_by_method(Date, Lat, Long, "maghrib", Time, "Egyptian_General_Authority") :-
    calculate_solar_time(Date, Lat, Long, _, Sunset),
    Time = Sunset.

calculate_prayer_time_by_method(Date, Lat, Long, "isha", Time, "Egyptian_General_Authority") :-
    calculate_solar_time(Date, Lat, Long, _, Sunset),
    % Adjust angle based on latitude
    (Lat > 28 -> Angle = 17.5; Angle = 18.0),
    calculate_time_offset(Sunset, Angle, Time).

% ============================================
% 4. QUERY IMPLEMENTATIONS WITH COMPREHENSIVE ERROR HANDLING
% ============================================

% 1. Minimum Isha prayer with robust error handling
minimum_isha(MinTime) :-
    findall(Time, prayer_time_db(_, _, "isha", Time, _), Times),
    Times <> [], % Check if list is not empty
    !,
    min_time_list(Times, MinTime).
minimum_isha("No data available") :-
    write("Warning: No prayer time data found in database."), nl.

% 2. Maximum Isha prayer with robust error handling
maximum_isha(MaxTime) :-
    findall(Time, prayer_time_db(_, _, "isha", Time, _), Times),
    Times <> [],
    !,
    max_time_list(Times, MaxTime).
maximum_isha("No data available") :-
    write("Warning: No prayer time data found in database."), nl.

% 3. Prayer times on a certain day with comprehensive validation
prayer_times_on_date(Date) :-
    valid_date(Date),
    !,
    write("Prayer times on ", Date, ":"), nl,
    (prayer_time_db(Date, Governorate, Prayer, Time, _) ->
        write("  ", Governorate, " - ", Prayer, ": ", Time), nl,
        fail
    ;
        write("  No prayer time data available for this date."), nl
    ).
prayer_times_on_date(Date) :-
    write("Error: Invalid date format or date out of range: '", Date, "'"), nl,
    write("Expected format: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., 2024-12-25)"), nl.

% 4. Prayer times for Giza with comprehensive validation
prayer_times_giza(Date) :-
    valid_date(Date),
    !,
    write("Prayer times for Giza on ", Date, ":"), nl,
    (prayer_time_db(Date, "Giza", Prayer, Time, _) ->
        write("  ", Prayer, ": ", Time), nl,
        fail
    ;
        handle_missing_data(Date, "Giza")
    ).
prayer_times_giza(Date) :-
    write("Error: Invalid date format or date out of range: '", Date, "'"), nl,
    write("Expected format: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., 2024-12-25)"), nl.

% 5. List of governorates
list_governorates :-
    write("Available Governorates in Egypt:"), nl,
    governorate_info(Governorate, _, _),
    write("  - ", Governorate), nl,
    fail.
list_governorates :-
    nl.

% ============================================
% 5. HELPER FUNCTIONS WITH IMPROVED VALIDATION
% ============================================

% Time comparison functions
time_less_than(Time1, Time2) :-
    time_to_minutes(Time1, Mins1),
    time_to_minutes(Time2, Mins2),
    Mins1 < Mins2.

time_greater_than(Time1, Time2) :-
    time_to_minutes(Time1, Mins1),
    time_to_minutes(Time2, Mins2),
    Mins1 > Mins2.

min_time_list([Time], Time).
min_time_list([H|T], Min) :-
    min_time_list(T, MinT),
    (time_less_than(H, MinT) -> Min = H; Min = MinT).

max_time_list([Time], Time).

time_to_minutes(Time, Minutes) :-
    fronttoken(Time, HStr, Rest),
    fronttoken(Rest, ":", MStr),
    str_int(HStr, Hours),
    str_int(MStr, Mins),
    Minutes = Hours * 60 + Mins.

minutes_to_time(Minutes, Time) :-
    Hours = Minutes div 60,
    Mins = Minutes mod 60,
    str_int(HStr, Hours),
    str_int(MStr, Mins),
    concat(HStr, ":", Temp),
    concat(Temp, MStr, Time).

% Comprehensive date validation
valid_date(Date) :-
    validate_date_string(Date),
    fronttoken(Date, YStr, Rest1),
    fronttoken(Rest1, "-", MStr),
    fronttoken(MStr, "-", DStr),
    str_int(YStr, Year),
    str_int(MStr, Month),
    str_int(DStr, Day),
    Year >= 2020, Year =< 2030,
    Month >= 1, Month =< 12,
    Day >= 1,
    days_in_month(Year, Month, MaxDays),
    Day <= MaxDays.

validate_date_string(Date) :-
    strlen(Date, 10), % YYYY-MM-DD format
    frontchar(Date, '2', _), % Starts with 2 for 2000s
    fronttoken(Date, YStr, Rest1),
    strlen(YStr, 4),
    fronttoken(Rest1, "-", MStr),
    strlen(MStr, 2),
    fronttoken(MStr, "-", DStr),
    strlen(DStr, 2).

    time_to_minutes(Sunrise, SRMins),
